source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 exam booklet screenshot, limits section only (also present in khexam_math_2022_2023.json, extracted from the source PDF)

exams.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា

questions.label: a
questions.technique: No indeterminate form: e^x is continuous and 2e^x never vanishes, so evaluate by direct substitution at x=0.

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=1. Rationalize both numerator and denominator by multiplying by (sqrt(x+3)+2) and (sqrt(x)+1); this turns the ratio into (x-1)(sqrt x+1) / [(x-1)(sqrt(x+3)+2)], and the (x-1) factors cancel.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=pi/3. Substitute t=x-pi/3; numerator becomes sqrt3·(-t), denominator sin t. Apply the sinc limit t/sin t → 1.
